orchestration_result.query: Build me a laddered bond portfolio for a 5-year horizon using investment-grade securities only.

bonds.analysis: To construct a laddered bond portfolio over a 5-year horizon, we will evenly distribute the maturities across the 1-year to 5-year range. This ensures that 20% of the portfolio will mature each year, providing a consistent cash flow and minimizing interest rate risk. By focusing on investment-grade securities, we adhere to the credit quality constraints. Each bond selected will have a maturity that fits into one of the five buckets, ensuring that no more than 20% of the portfolio is allocated to any single maturity year. This structure also helps in maintaining the portfolio duration below the 10-year limit, with an expected portfolio duration of around 3 years, well within the 7-year warning threshold.

orchestration_result.final_recommendation: Allocate 40% to bonds, distributing the allocation evenly across 1-year to 5-year maturities (8% each) to maintain a laddered portfolio structure. The remaining 60% of the portfolio will be allocated to other asset classes as per the risk parameters to ensure diversification and compliance with the 40% cap on any single asset class.
